verdicts.reason: A: about 100px of dead space on the left, while 'Every mixed case.' wraps to three lines and nearly touches '20% off'. 'Ends Sunday. Online only.' breaks into a ragged four-line stack, the product is tiny, and the purple circle is cut off from the product and stranded at the far-right edge, so the strip reads as a jammed row of fragments. B: has a clear left-to-right order, a strong headline and a well-placed CTA, and it keeps the product inside its circle. Its flaws: 'WEEKEND ONLY' is shrunk to near-illegible micro text, 'Every mixed case.' still wraps awkwardly to three lines, the circle touches the top and bottom edges, the fine print sits tight against the circle, and the right end is left empty.
